title: Avijjā
text: 2 Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || [page 031] XXXV. 55. 9] AVIJJĀ-VAGGO PATHAMO 31 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Kathan nu kho bhante jānato katham passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti || || 4 Cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti || || Rūpe aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjati || || Cakkhuviññāṇam || || Cakkhusamphassaṃ || || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjati || || 5-8 Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || Jivhaṃ || || Kāyaṃ || || 9 Manam aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjati || || Dhamme || || Manoviññāṇaṃ || || Manosamphassaṃ || || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukham vā || tam pi aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjati || || 10 Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti || ||
